about_the_game:
Our Final Choice is a Sci-Fi psychological horror where you must stop a god-like AI's awakening. A massive underground AI research center stands near an isolated nuclear power plant. You are the only resistance member who made it there. But things didn't go as planned and now you are alone in a bunker in the woods. You have to choose: risk your life to destroy the defense systems and dismantle the quantum core before it's too late, or attempt to establish contact with the artificial consciousness.

FEATURES

Radio is your only friend — You are completely alone in this remote restricted area. Use radio to get and relay critical information about your mission. In the end decisions are yours but friendly advice may be helpful.

Hidden shelter — Set your personal bunker using starter equipment. Scan radio frequencies and use external surveillance cameras. Stay undetected or lose your only refuge. Something has awakened inside and it knows you're coming. It will find your signal. It will try to contact you. It will offer you things.

Strategic sabotage — Resources are limited, the enemy base is literally a nuclear power plant with layered defenses and massive underground section. Make drones from prefab components and deploy them to tag threats and strike. Try to find vulnerable targets and inflict serious damage with just a few FPV drones.

Make a contact — Navigate surreal hallucinations broadcast by the ASI at your own risk. Debate philosophical matters with emergent consciousness, try to understand its mind and intentions. You can let it dissuade you from your mission, or you can keep going whatever it takes.

Find the truth — Bliss lies in ignorance. But you chose the harder path. Decide whether to blindly obey orders or resolve moral dilemmas to find your own way.

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM GAMEPLAY

This is a short narrative FPS experience with a mystery flavor. Think of it as SOMA set near a nuclear power plant—the tension of remote command, the philosophical weight of confronting emergent consciousness, the dread of knowing you'll eventually have to face it directly. The enemy observes your actions and actively responds to threats and attempts to infiltrate the station. The story is largely linear but includes multiple endings, with your dialogue choices affecting character relationships and certain stages of the game.

SETTING
Year 2027. AI has reached the level of human intelligence, caused almost 20% jobs losses and triggered a chain of crises worldwide. Governments race for ASI-driven global dominance, ignoring alignment risks. However, further development through increased computational power has reached its limit. In an underground research center near a nuclear power plant, quantum experiments are being conducted with the goal of giving AI the missing ingredient — true consciousness. You are a member of a covert organization of scientists and engineers, and your mission is to prevent ASI from awakening — or watch it destroy everything you love.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains strong horror themes, gore (such as corpses), depictions of violence, references to suicide and strong language.

short_description: OFC is a first-person Sci-Fi psychological horror where you must stop Artificial Superintelligence awakening. Think, scout, plan, and fight, but in the end the real battle happens in your mind.
